question: What attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation together constitute a great accomplishment
Such great accomplishment can belong to a practitioner
Possessing this accomplishment makes one dear to the yoginīs
inference: A practitioner endowed with the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: One who possesses the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation may become dear to the yoginīs.
